column1: # Seeding window must exceed simulation length so the bioen seeding fallback
# (simulate.py:534) can keep bootstrapping the population whenever bioen
# energy-budget mortality drives a species' gonad_ssb to zero. Without this
# the default seeding.year.max defaults to the species lifespan (cod=20y)
# and populations starve out structurally once the warm-up window closes.
